source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Check AST1060 Status is provision aspeed-pfr-tool -p show 2. Destroy the BMC active region 3. Use DediProg to program BMC firmware with bad-active region into the BMC SPI flash 4. Boot the BMC and AST1060 will recover BMC firmware 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

test_case.test_name: BMC FW Recovery — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Prove a provisioned AST1060/PFR detects an intentionally invalid BMC active region, restores it from the approved recovery source, verifies the recovered firmware and returns BMC services to the expected healthy version/state.
required_package: AST1060/PFR firmware, provision/lock state and recovery architecture
Exact SPI part, active/recovery address ranges and protected regions
Known-good/recovery/bad-active images, construction rules and hashes
DediProg model/adapter/voltage/procedure, full backup, stable power, console and rollback
test_case.test_command: Map exact SPI device/active/recovery regions and PFR lifecycle; back up full flash and configuration; verify DediProg adapter, voltage, image/hash and bad-active construction; qualified operator de-energizes/isolate-programs only the active target once; restore connections and stable power; capture AST1060 verification/recovery events and duration; confirm recovered hash/version, boot/services/network/SEL and immutable/non-target regions; retain external reflash rollback.
test_case.expected_result: 1. AST1060 checks BMC verify ok and BMC boot up success
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for BMC FW Recovery. The protected Criteria is `1.
